verdict.rationale: An employee referral flow is a fair axis for an ATS like Workable, but the evidence pack never mentions referrals. Nothing shows employees submitting referrals, tracking referral status, or seeing where a referral stands. The candidate-creation API, external recruiters endpoint, and pipeline stages are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented referral capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an employee, I can refer candidates through a real referral flow — submit, track status, and see where my referral stands
